title: Hanasato Minori — Synonyms For Tasty〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, everyone!
It's time for another MORE MORE JUMP! livestream♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Today's segment is titled...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: “Who Saw The Late Nite Wednesday Talk Show?! Let's Talk About What Happened!”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm sure a lot of you already know, but we got to appear on The Late Nite Wednesday Talk Show last week!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Today, you'll get to hear things about the shoot you won't hear anywhere else!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Finally!>
<I saw! It was so good!>
<Tell us about what happened behind the scenes!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I guess a lot of you did see it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Lemme see...
Yeah, wow! Most of them saw it as it aired!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all very much for watching!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, shall we begin by talking about the cafe we were at?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The truth is, we'd been there a few times already on our own.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, they all threw me a birthday party there one time.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<So, it was already pretty famous?>
<I'd been there before too. I was so surprised when I heard the news.>
<What?! I wanna go!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori was the one who originally told us about it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Some things happened and I ended up discovering it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (When I was first hired, they really took the time to teach me how to wait tables and decorate sweets...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I only have a little time left with them...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it has this really welcoming atmosphere because the manager and all the staff are so nice!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll tell you all about where it is and what's good on the menu, so get your notepad ready!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, let's start talking about what happened during our shoot.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: ...which is what happened when we ate our first parfait!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I didn't realize the Mount Everest parfait would be that big.>
<I've seen it on social media before, but it really is a mountain of sweets.>
<That was standard? They didn't do that specially for the show?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's really that big.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Pretty sure you're supposed to split it.>
<I don't know if I can handle all that whipped cream.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
The whipped cream you say?!
You bring up an excellent point!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, there's a ton of whipped cream and a mountain of strawberries.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But as you dig through the whipped cream, you'll start seeing all these little slices of strawberries!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, whenever you need to take a break from the sugariness of the whipped cream, those can act as your oasis.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's right. Those strawberries provided just the right amount of sourness to want to keep trying the sweet whipped cream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Exactly♪ And it was so good in the end!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Come to think of it, Minori, all you talked about was how “good” it was.>
<And “delicious”.>
<Let's work on your vocabulary for next time lol.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Wince*
I-I'll do my best.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Regardless, Minori, the smile you had on your face as you at it was so lovely.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I could tell that you were really enjoying it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<She's totally right!>
<You did make it look really, really good!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, what should we talk about next?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, there's Riser☆Fujin, and what we did to help the cafe when they were in trouble.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I cracked up when I saw Fujin walk in the door.>
<Tell us about what you did to help!>
<I wanna hear about both!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! So many comments! I can't see what you all wrote!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Then, why don't we go in order?
Riser☆Fujin seems like a good place to start.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Our stream went really well again today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It must be because everyone saw the show. We've been getting such a good response.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We have.
Actually, more people saw it than I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And some wrote in the comments about how they'd like to see us in more of those kinds of shows.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! A lot of people also seem really happy about being able to see us not just on these streams, but on TV now!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm really glad we decided to start doing this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, me too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we can't start resting on our laurels just yet.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because our goal is still to do a show at the Dome.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which means we'll need to keep increasing our name recognition.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, we just gotta keep doing lots and lots and lots more work!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whether it's TV or radio or anything else, let's do so much that we'll eventually be everywhere!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That's what I like to hear!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, let's keep this momentum going!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Minori & Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah!
